summary: Campaign QA and deployment reject missing or broken Klaviyo unsubscribe tags.
reason: The full-link unsubscribe tag breaks when used inside href, while tags hidden in non-rendered HTML do not provide a usable opt-out link.
validated_outcome: QA reports a dedicated unsubscribe finding, campaign deployment blocks invalid placement before API activity, and tests cover visible, broken, missing, and non-rendered tags.
